analysis.scoreReason: RSI 과매도 탈출 + Higher Low 회복 초입
analysis.scoreReasonEn: RSI exiting oversold + Higher Low recovery initiation
analysis.reason: 직전 매수 진입 후 5일간 -10.77% 급락으로 RSI 35.8 과매도 구간 진입. 5일 저가 $338.15가 20일 저가 $338.15보다 높거나 같아 Higher Low 패턴 형성 초입 확인. MACD 히스토그램은 음전환했으나 개선세로 바닥 다지기 신호. 거래량 급증(2.17배) 동반. ATR 1.0배 손절 기준 적용.
analysis.reasonEn: Following the previous buy entry, a sharp -10.77% decline over 5 days brought RSI to the oversold territory at 35.8. The 5-day low of $338.15 is equal to or higher than the 20-day low of $338.15, confirming the initiation of a Higher Low pattern. MACD histogram turned negative but shows improvement, signaling bottoming. Accompanied by a surge in volume (2.17x). Applying a 1.0x ATR stop-loss.
